title: Creature Addresses
prompt:

The open blue sky and treetops remain exactly as in the input. The tiny distant cyan point stays a tiny unresolved point at constant size; it never becomes an object, orb, person, sphere or projection. Do not show what the creature is looking at. No speech, no human gesture. Background must remain unchanged. Continuous restrained motion with one-second lead-in and lead-out.

MOTION REPAIR LOCK: Preserve exactly the subjects, composition, illustration style and physical setting visible in the input image. Fine controlled ink contours and detailed painterly materials. One continuous full-frame16:9 shot. Do not invent or reveal any subject absent from the input. No people, faces, holograms, spacecraft, symbols, text, montage, cuts or transitions.
